mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5 for two consecutive months, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 200 and the federal funds rate is below 0.25%, it indicates a period of persistent inflation under accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, a sustained increase in housing starts above 550 thousand units signals strengthening consumer confidence and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-recession recovery phase when HOUST > 550, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales exceed 360,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 360000, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining unemployment below 9.5% and rising employment above 129,000 thousand indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary policy tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate above 0.5% signals reduced liquidity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
